answer: The yarrow pool is mutual cover where each member's cover hangs on one anchor, its funding wallet, with a premium of $5 times its cluster size. One agent pays $5 for $5,000 of cover, while 100 clones on one wallet each pay $500, so the farm owes $50,000 where 100 honest agents pay $500. Members whisper signed flags on matching claims, and five rotating auditors check 10% of claims every epoch. Correlated fraud burns the whole cluster's cover and freezes its wallet for 10 epochs. A barn roof works the same way. One rotten beam drops the whole roof on everyone beneath it.
